methodology.candidatePopulation: Forward-shadow candidate records only; historical backfill is excluded.
methodology.baselinePopulation: MTF_BASELINE_V1 SCALP records using M5 entry timeframe.
methodology.pairing: One-to-one within each experiment family, same market and direction, nearest entry candle within 15 minutes.
methodology.reuse: A baseline signal may be independently paired once in each separate experiment family.
limitations: This is a contemporaneous signal co-occurrence comparison, not a counterfactual replay.
A missing baseline match means no qualifying baseline signal was recorded in the matching window; it is not a baseline loss.
Candidate and baseline entries, stop distances, targets, management rules, and outcome horizons may differ.
Candle-based outcomes do not prove fills, spread-adjusted returns, or realized account profit.
Do not rank or promote strategies from this report alone. A matched replay with identical entry and exit assumptions is required before performance claims.

strategies.label: M5 breakout / M5 retest / M15 confirmation
